subject: Geopolitics
title: Resource Nationalism
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Resource Nationalism.

hook.text: Bolivia nationalized its natural gas in 2006. Foreign companies lost billions overnight. The people cheered.

buildup.text: Resource nationalism is when governments seize control of natural resources from foreign or private firms.

discovery.text: Leaders use it to win public support. Reclaiming national wealth from foreigners is politically powerful.

twist.text: But nationalization drives away investment. Without foreign tech and cash, production usually falls.

climax.text: Venezuela nationalized oil and production cratered. Mexico did the same and rebuilt slowly. Execution matters.

punchline.text: Owning the resource is easy. Running it is the hard part.

quiz.question: What is resource nationalism?
options: Exporting resources only to allied nations
Government seizure of natural resources from foreign or private firms
Using resources to fund military expansion
